comments.author: PhantomKraken99
comments.content: Draw 2 Save is absurdly creative! Just saved my stickman from a hungry fish by drawing an umbrella - who thinks of this stuff? 10/10 unexpectedness.

comments.author: NeonKatana_X
comments.content: My brain hurts (in a good way). That level where you need to draw stairs to escape rising water made me feel like an actual genius when I figured it out.

comments.author: CtrlAltYeet
comments.content: Bruh this game turns stick figures into life-or-death situations?? hilarious AND stressful at the same time. Def recommend Draw 2 Save for quick brain workouts!

comments.author: CosmicRevolver87
comments.content: Never knew stickmen needed so much rescuing! Some puzzles are easy but others...oof. Still can't beat level 42 with the dancing bear trap.

comments.author: PotionMishap
comments.content: Draw 2 Save makes me feel smart and stupid simultaneously. Pro tip: sometimes the dumbest-looking drawings actually work best. That's the magic!

comments.author: StalkingPhoenix42
comments.content: 5-star concept but gets repetitive after 2 hours. Needs more scenarios beyond feeding fish/avoiding water. Devs please update!

comments.author: xX_IdeaThief_Xx
comments.content: My stickman drowned 17 times before I realized you can DRAW A RAFT. This game tests your IQ by first destroying your dignity.

comments.author: BroadswordCasual
comments.content: Perfect toilet game! Short levels, instant retries. Though my coworkers probably wonder why I'm giggling at stickman disasters...

comments.author: LaggingLeviathan
comments.content: 50% of my drawings look like toddler scribbles yet still somehow save the stickman? Draw 2 Save's physics engine is either brilliant or broken, can't decide.

comments.author: NoobMaster42
comments.content: Expected generic puzzler, got absolute chaos instead. That level with the falling anvils and banana peels? Pure digital madness (in the best way).
